blocking.issue: This is a regression from the wording the previous L2-4 fix proposed. As written, the settlement rule charges nothing and releases all of R when a reservation is followed by no provider attempt, because 'usage summed over attempts' is 0 and no attempt 'lacked usage'. That case covers a guardrail block, RZ-AI-004 and a Semantic Cache hit. The owning document and pack 8.9 charge all of R in that case today. Releasing R there is only a proposal of OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15, and the ADR's own More information says that proposal does not apply until OQ-15 closes. So the normative row contradicts the owning document, pack 8.9 and the ADR itself.
blocking.evidence: ADR line 57: "`onLog` charges usage summed over attempts, plus all of R once per request if an attempt lacked usage (degraded-state metric), and releases the rest". Owning doc, Settlement: "| No provider attempt after reservation | Guardrail block, `RZ-AI-004`, Semantic Cache hit | All of R (pack 8.9); proposed: nothing (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15; ...) | None |". Pack 8.9: "When usage is missing (interrupted stream, no usage reported), charge all of R". ADR line 138: "OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 proposes charging R per attempt without usage and releasing R when no attempt ran; ... until it closes pack 8.9 applies as written."
blocking.fix: Line 57: change "plus all of R once per request if an attempt lacked usage (degraded-state metric), and releases the rest" to "plus all of R once per request if an attempt lacked usage (degraded-state metric) or none ran, and releases the rest" (+3 words). The body is exactly at the 1,500-word maximum, so offset the added words in text that no earlier finding depends on. Line 88: "budgets and cost records use billed fields, and cost records carry" becomes "budgets and cost use billed fields; cost records carry" (-2). Line 137: "The `failureMode` default of `ai.token-budget` stays OQ-configuration-model-8." becomes "`ai.token-budget`'s default `failureMode` stays OQ-configuration-model-8." (-2).

non_blocking.suggestion: Previous L2-4 is resolved in substance, but the bound is still not quoted exactly. Line 31 says "plus unstreamed hidden reasoning (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17) ... as [Settlement] states". Settlement actually says "hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama`", because on Anthropic Messages C is written to `max_tokens`, "which also bounds thinking". Also, "pack 8.9 omits both extra terms (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15)" credits OQ-15 with both terms, although OQ-17 owns the hidden-reasoning term. The recommended wording, if words can be found, is: "plus `gemini` and `ollama` hidden reasoning above C (hypothesis; SM-10), as [Settlement] states; pack 8.9 omits both extra terms (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15, OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17)" (+4 words). This is not blocking because the ADR's bound is looser, so it is still safe, and L1 raised the same point as non-blocking.

Line 51 adds "assumes the Route has exactly one upstream leg and no `composition` (proposed validation code: OQ-ai-llm-gateway-16)". The owning document's Surface decoder section does not state this constraint, and OQ-ai-llm-gateway-16 option (a) does not list the code, although the OQ asks generally which AI registrations to add. The Configuration model allows several `upstreams` or `composition` on any Route. This is not a contradiction, but when the owning document is next revised it should add the constraint and the code to OQ-16 so that the two documents agree.

The verifier WARN at line 103 ('Planned (M3) but has no matching item under the M3 section of docs/roadmap/01-roadmap-and-milestones.md') is not a FAIL. The roadmap's M3 section should list AI configuration validation (RZ-CFG-034) when the roadmap is next revised.

The body is exactly 1,500 words by the verifier's rule (front matter, fences and comments excluded), which is the adr_common maximum. Any future addition must be offset in the same revision, without removing text that resolved an earlier blocking finding.
